interpretation: AP-PS55 with partial-centroid subtraction, metric size and Z-up axes passes the existing median criteria. F1 and hidden-surface coverage improve markedly over PCN.
All three sampling seed aggregates pass. They reuse the same 20 observations and eight boxes, not independent object generalization tests.
AP-PS55 radius .5 Y-up also passes and improves the same-frame PCN baseline. The gain cannot be assigned solely to removing scale normalization.
Radius 1 fails for this PS55 bundle; the official cropped ShapeNet55 unit-radius path has not been validated because its original checkpoint is unavailable.
Only 12 of 20 seed-zero observations meet all five geometry conditions individually. No all-input or general-object guarantee is established.

verification.canonical_reason: Known optional development image preparation remains incomplete; required/extended, real-RMW and isolated-release gates were not run.

limitations: Third-party inference-only AP-PS55 mirror; original-author file equivalence and paper-best checkpoint status unproven.
Not the unavailable cropped ShapeNet55 checkpoint or a confirmation of that official normalization path.
Existing static box replay with red connected-component segmentation only. No unseen shape, size, noise, real sensor, grasp or live calibration integration validation.
PCN and PS55 bundles differ in weights, output density (16384 versus 8192), grouper configuration and parameter count. Not a weights-only ablation.
The existing Triton FPS/Torch gather backend is reused; no direct comparison against a compiled native upstream CUDA binary.
GPU2 was reserved exclusively among visible devices, but other host GPU2 activity was present at initial inventory. Wall times exclude acquisition and live Sim/MPPI coexecution.
No production adapter, model dependency or automatic collision/grasp/motion use was enabled.
